messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good, but the fix looks partial: ofd_failure_domain has three unsynchronized accesses and only the ofd_statfs() one is covered here, so the same pattern is left behind in failure_domain_show() and ofd_failure_domain_write(). Since the field is a standalone __u32 with no invariant tying it to another field, READ_ONCE()/WRITE_ONCE() on all of them would close this out in one go and avoid taking ofd_flags_lock in the statfs RPC path. Details inline.

Uploaded patch set 2.
